title.narrative: I fördjupad studie av TVET / ekonomisk egenmakt för ungdomar portfölj i Liberia
In-depth study of TVET/Youth Economic Empowerment Portfolio in Liberia

description.narrative: Denna studie rör ambassadens portfölj för jobbskapande och kompetensutveckling för ungdomar och ska granska Liberias yrkestekniska utbildning samt den liberianska kontexten gällande ungdomars utbildning och ekonomisk egenmakt. Studiens slutsatser och rekommendationer kommer att informera ambassaden i att utveckla ett nytt program inom kompetensutveckling och ekonomisk egenmakt för ungdomar.

This study shall assess the Embassy's employment and skills development portfolio, as well as examine Liberia’s current TVET/youth economic empowerment environment and present conclusion and recommendations, that will inform the Embassy's contribution in skills development and economic empowerment for young people.

This was an in-depth study on Technical Vocational Education and Training (TVET) meant to examine Liberia’s current TVET/youth economic empowerment environment and the Embassy’s youth empowerment and TVET portfolio, and present conclusions and recommendations. The scope of the study was to review the results and plans of the Embassy´s portfolio related to TVET and youth employment and empowerment; consult with relevant national and international partners including beneficiaries; assess the current TVET/youth empowerment context, and identify innovative approaches to TVET/youth economic empowerment. All the deliverables as outlined in the ToR; inception report, fact finding mission, validation workshop, in-depth study final report, in-depth study final report summary, and PowerPoint presentation of in-depth study were submitted. The in-depth study was used to inform the Embassy with regards to a new contribution to UNIDO for TVET support.
